name: MCP Tool Call
description: mcp_tools_call: Call one tool on a remote MCP endpoint. Supply server, the exact toolName returned by discovery, and arguments matching that tool's inputSchema (use {} for a tool with no arguments). When using an MCP token, pass the same token used for discovery; only its offered tools and granted capabilities are available. Wait for the result before reporting success; an error or pending job is not evidence that the action succeeded.

server.description: HTTP(S) MCP server URL. A URL with no path implies /mcp; an explicit path is used as-is; a trailing slash expresses an exact root endpoint

toolName.description: Exact name of the remote MCP tool, as returned by discovery; custom token aliases may differ from the underlying operation name

token.description: API access token to use for the delegated MCP request

arguments.description: Arguments to the MCP tool call

output.description: The MCP tool output. Typically the content array or a structuredContent Object
